comments: cef1b57b: This block initializes the totals page, setting up headers and iterating over divisions to display their respective total delinquencies.
272e8f5e: Iterate through the divisions and display their names and total number of delinquent records.
76d143f6: End of the program.
1bab6aff: Prints the header for the totals page, including the division name and the total delinquencies.
465cd7cd: Fill the rest of the page with blank lines up to the footer.
8a3b9e11: Look up the division by name and print the total delinquencies for that division if available.
53d25a43: Check if the output is to a terminal (screen) device.
cc32eea3: Prompt the user to continue with <RET> or quit with ^ if the output device is a terminal.
d9db2bd8: Reset the page number when the division changes.
30874f87: Print the report header, including the report type, listing criteria, and the current date.
5bdde1f2: For event date reports, format the header to include event date, patient name, and patient ID.
68815e51: For non-event date reports, format the header to include patient name, patient ID, and event date.
4ce22aa6: Print the column headers for the detailed report sections.
133eeb99: Print the additional headers for reports not specifically filtered by physician.
8c23a080: Print the headers for reports filtered by physician, including report type and status if applicable.
fcbad9ca: End of header printing function.
87a9399b: Clean up and kill local variables used throughout the program.
a4464200: Further clean up by killing additional variables and temporary globals used.
3018ce56: Kill variables used for RT (real-time) processing and cleanup ^UTILITY global.
560a45d4: Close the device used for output and perform any final cleanup operations.
bb463018: Print the count of reports for a physician if there are no more records to process.
21a51925: Print the count of reports for a service point if there are no more records to process for that service point.
c45cbcd8: Print the subtotal count for a service if there are no more records to process for that service.
365ada6b: End of the subroutine.
47b5f6c5: Print the type of discharge if available.
428facb2: If the detailed report type is selected, print the status of the report if available.
25e247ab: Print the total number of days late for the record.
3426d723: End of the subroutine for printing report details.
